metric_definitions.time: Seconds relative to replay origin, after warmup. cutoff_time = last actual sent_at + drain_timeout.
metric_definitions.duration: min(actual terminal duration, cutoff_time), including initial idle and final drain.
metric_definitions.latencies: TTFT/E2E: ALL planned requests. Missing first token / unsuccessful completion = +infinity, serialized as >cutoff. Linear quantiles on extended reals.
metric_definitions.tpot: (E2E-TTFT)/(output_tokens-1); only completed before cutoff with output_tokens>1; count reports sample size.
metric_definitions.slo: ALL planned requests; unfinished/failed/unsent/undefined metrics are misses, including TTFT-only SLO.
metric_definitions.throughput: All output tokens received in timestamped SSE chunks by cutoff, including partial/failed requests. Input counted once for each request delivering a first token by cutoff (includes cached input); neither queued input nor unobserved partial prefill is counted. Divide by duration_sec.
metric_definitions.cache: Completed responses with cached_tokens only; missing is null. PD decode metadata does not measure prefill cache.
metric_definitions.itl: Observed SSE intervals for completed requests; batched chunks do not reveal exact per-token times.
